articles.summary: Invalid commands can reveal what firmware does beyond its visible response. Learn how PowerFuzzer uses command-response-power evidence to detect hidden commands, firmware drift, undocumented functionality, and potential backdoors in black-box embedded systems.
articles.title: Why Invalid Commands Are Useful Evidence in Firmware Testing

articles.summary: By combining AI-powered fuzzing with power side-channel analysis, PowerFuzzer detects undocumented functionality, hidden behaviour, firmware changes, and potential backdoors without requiring source code access. It supports the assessment of embedded systems across aerospace, automotive, industrial, security, networking, and critical infrastructure applications.
articles.title: AI-Powered Firmware Assessment Without Source Code
